tl0001.name: Archivist Mara
tl0001.line: Dorian's last travel ledger is in the library. The court holds the key to his western route.

choices.label: Ask for the old route
choices.reply: Mara marks a safe path through the pale stones in Dorian's ledger. Carry the route west.

choices.label: Ask the king for aid
choices.reply: Mara suggests seeking Edmon's seal before leaving the city. The king can authorize help.

choices.label: Leave it for later
choices.reply: Mara closes the ledger. The western trail will have to be found without its guide.

tl0001.name: King Edmon
tl0001.line: I am Alsperia's original king. I grant you a map and shelter; return with knowledge, not conquest.

tl0001.name: Queen Alisande
tl0001.line: Edmon is my husband and king. His trust opens this road, and I expect you to honor it.

tl0008.name: Scholar Inessa
tl0008.line: The route index was scraped where the western landmarks should be. I need the market ledger to restore the missing marks.

choices.label: Copy the rune index
choices.reply: Inessa copies the pale-stone marks into your field notes. Tessa can use them to avoid the watchpost.

choices.label: Seal the damaged leaf
choices.reply: Inessa seals the fragile page. You have the court's route, but the damaged landmarks remain uncertain.

tl0008.name: Royal Scribe Oren
tl0008.line: Dorian's name appears in the oldest catalog. The entry says he feared the purpose of the traveller more than the road itself.

tl0002.name: Scout Tessa
tl0002.line: Pale stones mark the safe ground. The moss hides old snares, so watch where you step.

route_lines.1: Mara's ledger marked the pale stones correctly. We can skirt the ruined watchpost before the stalker finds us.
route_lines.2: Edmon's waywarden is already scouting ahead. Keep to the track while he draws the stalker off.

responses.line: Inessa's copied rune index matches the pale stones. We can skirt the watchpost if the stalker is near.

tl0002.name: Lost Wayfarer
tl0002.line: Something circles the ruined watchpost. I heard it answer my name from the trees.

tl0009.name: Courier Pell
tl0009.line: I found a charcoal rubbing under the watchpost stair. The western arch is marked, but the stalker kept me from carrying it onward.

choices.label: Mark it for repair
choices.reply: Pell and Tessa mark the damaged stair for repair. She copies the western arch into her field book.

choices.label: Leave a warning
choices.reply: You leave a warning for the next traveller and keep the rubbing. The watchpost remains unsafe.

tl0009.name: Waywarden Saren
tl0009.line: Edmon's seal sent me to count the road markers. A patrol can guard a path, but only a traveller can decide where it leads.

tl0003.name: Dorian the Seer
tl0003.line: I hid the scrolls because a road between worlds magnifies the purpose of whoever crosses it.

responses.line: Tessa's repaired watchpost marks the western arch. The scrolls will be easier to carry home without losing the return path.

tl0003.name: Lorian Guardian
tl0003.line: The vault is not a prize. Prove you can leave its door closed before you ask it to open.

tl0010.name: Gallery Keeper
tl0010.line: The three marks are passage, return, and restraint. Only one keeps a traveller from opening a gate for its own sake.

choices.label: Name restraint
choices.reply: The keeper accepts restraint as the answer. The gallery record can be carried without opening its sealed niches.

choices.label: Demand passage
choices.reply: The keeper refuses the demand. The sealed niches stay shut, and the warning remains unresolved.

tl0010.name: Dorian's Echo
tl0010.line: A warning is not a lock. It is a question the traveller must answer before choosing to cross.

tl0004.name: King Edmon
tl0004.line: You have returned with the scrolls. Tell the court what they can do, and what they must not do.

tl0004.name: Queen Alisande
tl0004.line: Knowledge won in darkness deserves careful study. I will argue for patience before the nobles.

tl0011.name: Captain Rovan
tl0011.line: The western road can be guarded, but soldiers cannot decide what a world-crossing spell is for.

choices.label: Keep the road open
choices.reply: Rovan will keep the road open for scholars and travellers under the court's watch.

choices.label: Restrict the scrolls
choices.reply: Rovan records the court's caution. Access to the scrolls will require the king and queen's leave.

tl0011.name: Queen Alisande
tl0011.line: Edmon and I will hear the witnesses before the court seals its account. The people who could be harmed deserve a voice.

tl0012.name: Warden Celene
tl0012.line: The breach repeats the king's last spoken thought. The ward lines hold, but the eastern stair is bending inward.

choices.label: Reinforce the ward
choices.reply: Celene strengthens the outer ward. It may hold through one more surge while the party descends.

choices.label: Record the pulse
choices.reply: Celene records the pulse without changing the ward. The pattern may help identify the echo below.

tl0012.name: Magister Vael
tl0012.line: I marked the pulse in the courtyard slate. The vault below answers in the same rhythm; we should descend before the next surge.

responses.line: Celene's reinforced ward gives us a narrow window. Descend before the next surge.
Celene's pulse record may reveal how the echo repeats. Descend and compare it with the vault.

tl0005.name: Magister Vael
tl0005.line: The observatory wards bend toward the breach. The sealed lecture vault is answering voices from below.

tl0005.name: Queen Alisande
tl0005.line: I will hold the wardens at the perimeter. Do not mistake the echo for a command.

tl0006.name: Ealdrin
tl0006.line: This living record says a Tear may answer a powerful mind that questions its own limits.

tl0006.name: Queen Alisande
tl0006.line: We need scholars and warders before we follow the second Tear. I will not leave the record unread.

tl0007.name: Queen Vaelthira
tl0007.line: My sanctuary's Tear speaks with a familiar voice. I ask you to study it before choosing what to do.

tl0007.name: Seraphina Everglow
tl0007.line: The ward diagrams are ready. We can observe the Tear without provoking it.
